types.definition: An application demands a property level the current material lacks; the performance gap that motivates the work.
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists. Distinct from HYP/gap: the gap is in the material, not in knowledge.

types.definition: A phenomenon has not been directly observed/measured in some regime (time, length, T, rate) because of method limits.
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists. Leads to a DES/method choice rather than a material choice — different next inference.

types.definition: The proposed approach expected to close the need or gap (e.g. add reinforcement, alloy, dope), stated as a testable expectation.
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists.

types.definition: Choice of the base material system and its constituents, with the stated reason.
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists.

types.definition: The independent variable systematically varied across samples (composition, temperature, time...). Variable and levels go in attrs.
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists. Needed as the anchor for later compare_*_across_conditions operations.

types.definition: Choice of a probing method because it enables a measurement otherwise impossible (resolution, in situ, time).
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists.

types.definition: A decision about how samples/regions/shots are selected or pooled, usually forced by an observation.
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists. Carries validity reasoning (independence, representativeness).

types.definition: Specimen geometry/format chosen for the experiment (thin film, pillar, powder), with reason.
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists.

types.definition: Primary synthesis/fabrication route producing the material. Technique and parameters in attrs.
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists.

types.definition: An external stimulus (laser pulse, load step, field, quench) applied during observation whose response IS the object of study.
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists. Differs from fabrication: it does not make the material, it perturbs it in situ; next inference is kinetics, not structure-of-product.

types.definition: Image readout of where a feature (particles, second phase, pores) sits: uniformity, clustering, alignment.
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists.

types.definition: Image readout of a size of features (grains, particles, pores), single value or distribution.
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists.

types.definition: Image readout of a boundary between constituents: sharpness, reaction layer, debonding, gaps.
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists.

types.definition: Image of a failure surface read for fracture features (dimples, cleavage, tear ridges, pull-out).
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists. Leads to failure-mode inference rather than structure.

types.definition: Images of the same kind of region across time/states (in situ or before/after) read for change in shape/size.
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists.

types.definition: Diffraction readout: positions of reflections/rings matched to phases or orientation.
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists.

types.definition: Diffraction readout converted to phase amounts via intensity integration or profile refinement.
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists. Distinct from phase_reflections: supports STR/phase/fraction, not identity.

types.definition: Strength readouts (YS, UTS, UCS, hardness) from mechanical tests, typically vs a design variable.
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists.

types.definition: Strain or strain-rate vs time curves under constant load/temperature (creep, relaxation).
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists.

types.definition: Rate readout vs driving force plotted to extract a sensitivity (creep rate vs stress, strain-rate sensitivity).
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists. Unsure: could merge into OBS/derived/fitted_parameter.

types.definition: A parameter obtained by fitting a model or linearisation to other observations (exponent, activation energy, threshold).
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists. Its evidential status depends on a KNW model, so the next step differs from a raw readout.

types.definition: Fraction/extent of a process vs time assembled from many individual measurements.
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists.

types.definition: A map/diagram (TTT, phase map, Ashby-type) constructed from reduced data.
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists.

types.definition: Computed estimate of an experimental condition that could not be measured (temperature history, stress state).
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists. Role is to parameterize other observations, not to evidence a claim.

types.definition: Output of a theoretical model for the same quantity as an experiment, used for validation.
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists.

types.definition: Computed thermodynamic quantity vs state variable (ΔG, H vs T) used as model input.
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists. Unsure: could be KNW/database_value.

types.definition: Which phases are present.
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists. (PROTOCOL's own example).

types.definition: How much of a phase is present, including its evolution in time.
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists.

types.definition: Grain/crystallite size claim; refine/coarsen as attr direction.
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists.

types.definition: Spatial distribution/homogeneity of a second constituent.
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists.

types.definition: Shape of structural units (lenticular, acicular, equiaxed).
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists.

types.definition: State of an interface between constituents: bonding, reaction products, defects.
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists.

types.definition: Strength-type property; which strength (YS, UTS, UCS) in attrs.
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists.

types.definition: Resistance to time-dependent deformation expressed as rate.
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists.

types.definition: Stress below which a deformation process effectively stops.
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists. Unsure: may be attr of a PRP/mechanical/critical_value.

types.definition: How the material fails (ductile, brittle, mixed, interfacial).
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists.

types.definition: Rate of a phase change or reaction as a function of condition.
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists.

types.definition: A quantity whose main argumentative role is to identify a mechanism via a lookup (stress exponent, activation energy, Avrami n, Tafel slope).
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists. Changes next inference: it is matched against KNW/diagnostic_lookup to select a MEC.

types.definition: Material performs under a stated service condition (T, load, environment, cycles).
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists.

types.definition: Mechanism by which processing produces a structure (nucleation, growth restriction, recrystallisation).
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists.

types.definition: Mechanism by which structure sets a property (strengthening/weakening). Sign in attrs.
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists.

types.definition: The identified rate-controlling elementary process (climb, diffusion, nucleation, interface motion).
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists.

types.definition: Classification of a phase change pathway (martensitic, diffusional, massive, autocatalytic nucleation).
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists. Unsure vs rate_controlling_step; kept separate because it is a categorical classification, not a rate step.

types.definition: A prior result on a similar system used as analogy or support.
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists.

types.definition: A named model/formalism used to fit or predict.
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists.

types.definition: A known mapping from a diagnostic value to a mechanism (n≈5 ⇒ climb).
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists.

types.definition: A tabulated property of a constituent used as premise.
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists.

types.definition: Discussion that the design variable improves one property while not/negatively affecting another; identifies an optimum.
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists.

types.definition: Result compared with prior reports.
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists.

types.definition: Verdict on agreement between model prediction and experiment, with where it fails.
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists.

types.definition: A deviating datum explained by an experimental artefact or special cause.
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists.

types.definition: Stated limit of the method or data that bounds a claim.
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists.

types.definition: Next experiment or open question proposed.
types.why_not_existing: v00 has only the level-1 stage; no subtype exists.

rels.definition: An OBS is transformed into another OBS by data processing (subtraction, integration, fitting, re-plotting, resampling). Carries mm_op.
rels.why_not_existing: evidences requires a claim as target; many papers chain OBS→OBS before any claim (Acta: pattern→fraction→kinetic curve→TTT→Ea).

rels.definition: A computed or measured quantity supplies a parameter/condition value used to interpret another OBS or fit (temperature assignment, nucleation density input).
rels.why_not_existing: premise_for is for KNW; evidences implies support of a claim. Here the node is an input, not evidence.

rels.definition: A limitation, caveat or anomaly bounds the scope or confidence of a claim without refuting it.
rels.why_not_existing: rules_out is too strong; contrasts is symmetric comparison.

mm_ops.definition: Compare the same kind of image across panels that differ in one design variable and read the change.
Judge uniformity/clustering/alignment of features across a field of view.
Use a high-magnification view of one location to judge a local feature (interface, defect) claimed to be representative.
Measure sizes of discrete features (grains, particles) from an image.
Match visible features to a known class that implies a mechanism (dimples⇒ductile; lenticular⇒martensitic).
Compare images of the same/similar region before, during and after a stimulus.
mm_ops.why_not_existing: mm_op vocabulary empty in v00. Differs from compare_panels_across_conditions: variable is time/state within one specimen, not a design variable.

mm_ops.definition: Count features (nuclei, grains, particles) per area/grain to get a number density.
Read monotonic trend/saturation of a quantity across ordered categories or x.
Read two quantities on the same plot that respond differently to the same variable (YS up, UTS flat).
Compare the position/level of curves for different conditions on shared axes.
Read a defined point (minimum, onset, peak, plateau) from each curve.
Fit a line on a transformed (log–log, Arrhenius) plot and read slope/intercept as a parameter.
Re-plot data against a normalised/corrected variable and check that curves from different conditions merge; the merge supports the normalising hypothesis.
Read where a curve crosses a critical level (transition T, limit) to get a time or window.
Assign reflections/rings/peaks to phases via reference positions.
Compare an experimental pattern to simulated ones to identify orientation/phase.
Subtract a reference-state pattern/spectrum to isolate the signal of the new component.
Integrate peak areas and convert ratios into phase/component fractions.
Read the x value where each curve reaches fixed y levels (10/50/90%) to build a new diagram.
Classify curve shape against an expected template (sigmoid, C-curve, power law) and infer from match/mismatch.
Overlay a model prediction/fit on data and judge agreement region by region.
Assemble single-shot/per-sample readouts taken at different delays or conditions into one time or condition series.
Least-squares fit of a closed-form expression to a computed/measured curve so it can be reused as model input.
Identify a point/series deviating from the trend of others and set it aside.

comments: Emerging hierarchy: level 2 of OBS is the measurement FAMILY (imaging, diffraction, mechanical, derived, computation) and level 3 the READOUT role (feature_size, feature_distribution, phase_reflections vs phase_quantification). The key structural insight from the Acta paper is that OBS→OBS data reduction is often the longest part of a spine (pattern→fraction→kinetic curve→TTT→fitted Ea); without rel reduces_to plus OBS/derived/* the graph cannot follow the argument. I argue strongly for: PRP/mechanism_diagnostic + KNW/diagnostic_lookup (a very common materials inference pattern: measure exponent/activation energy, look up mechanism), PRC/stimulus/transient vs PRC/fabrication (in situ papers study the process itself), and mm_op collapse_curves_by_normalization (F7b JMA: evidence is the MERGING of curves, not any value). Unsure about: OBS/mechanical/rate_vs_stress (probably merge into OBS/derived/fitted_parameter with attrs); OBS/computation/thermodynamic_function (could be KNW); PRP/mechanical/threshold_stress (maybe PRP/mechanical/critical_value); MEC/transformation_mode vs MEC/rate_controlling_step; and whether OBS level 2 should be modality-like (imaging) at all given modality is already an attribute — an alternative is OBS/<readout> directly (OBS/feature_size) with technique in attrs. mm_ops recognize_morphological_signature and read_curve_shape_against_template are the same operation (template matching) on images vs curves; could merge into match_to_known_signature. Observed repeatedly: captions/text over-claim what images show (grain size unreadable in JMA F1; noisy F7 lens grains), and images carry unmentioned info (liquid hump in Acta F4; two-stage shoulders in F5; crossing creep lines in JMA F7a). Suggest a node field image_support: {shown|partly|not_visible} so the graph records when a text claim is only nominally attached to a figure.
